blocking_findings.title: Types still prepays linear work for newly unbounded repeated role searches
blocking_findings.root_cause: The former two-role bound made these linear searches constant-size. Removing that bound exposes variable nested scans without an accompanying debit or indexed traversal. helper_flow substitute calls forwarded.roles.iter().find_map for every child event. child_work and Size::reserve prepay event/node/edge counts, not event_count times role_count. helpers::forwarded_contract scans contract.roles for each actual environment argument but prepays role_count*3+arguments.len(). call_helper similarly scans signature.callable for each argument after a linear argument/role reservation.
blocking_findings.concrete_static_work: For R ordered shared positions of one generic F, child events visiting all R positions require R*(R+1)/2 mapping comparisons per substitution, while this consumer's local debit is O(R). A parent with M static calls repeats that work M times. All positions may share one ClosureId, so Bindings stays Inline and its Extended-vector/COW payment cannot account for the scans. The once-per-template quadratic declaration validation does not prepay arbitrarily many later call-site/event substitutions. This is a source-reachable construction permitted by the new three_same_generic_shared_roles control; no measured timing or executed hostile budget result is claimed here.
blocking_findings.independent_cross_check: Analyze helper_flow::remap already prepays events.len()*(roles.len()+2); Verify helpers::Forwarded::remap prepays calls.len()*(mapping.len()+1), and its forwarded mapping pays a role product. Types closures::State::snapshot only subtracts its explicit entries argument; there is no implicit role multiplier in the quoted linear reservations. The same missing scans are present at author freeze 365235ae and integrated 54b1b8f.
blocking_findings.impact: The request's work allowance does not bound the newly enlarged Types role substitution/classification work according to the accepted changes contract. This is a compiler resource-accounting blocker, not a demonstrated origin/loan safety bypass or ABI corruption.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use bounded positional/indexed traversal for these ordered role tables, or prepay the actual additional comparison product from the same live allowance before the searches. Preserve the old one/two-role fee contract unless an actual necessary fee migration is separately proposed and evidenced; do not raise default limits. Add a same-F many-position nested-call/event control using an existing target, verify exact N/N-1/fresh at Types, and recheck the independent consumer results on the final fix freeze.

checked_nonblocking_boundaries.result: Callable generic indices are dense in declaration order and separate from runtime parameter positions and original source generic ordinals. Bindings compares the full Inline/Extended Option<ClosureId> inventory, not a two-slot prefix. bind rejects inconsistent actual ClosureIds for one generic; later slots participate in plan keys, helper_instances and generated labels. Valid populated extended keys have deterministic width. Third/fourth swaps therefore select distinct concrete helpers. Reference transport/COW shares compiler metadata only. No new runtime Rc or environment carrier is introduced.

checked_nonblocking_boundaries.area: Distinct actual runtime origins and independent proofs
checked_nonblocking_boundaries.result: Each layer owns its own origin state and propagation. Actual role ordinals are stored separately from producer flags; distinct roles join to an unselectable mixed sentinel, and producer/unknown flags prevent recovering a singleton. Analyze retains borrowed participation through mixed joins. All actual parameters are seeded by their actual ordered position, including same-F/same-ClosureId positions; concrete type identity supplies neither a selected instance nor apartness. Child events are replaced at each actual static call site. The precise Analyze CFG path preserves live/moved/alias distinctions with widened origins. No producer solver is imported into Verify.

checked_nonblocking_boundaries.area: Complete role/effect table and source life modes
checked_nonblocking_boundaries.result: Analyze and Verify require exact coverage/order of actual environment parameters and reject reused actual local slots. Verify reconstructs closure identity, supported kind, Address mutable/shared mode, Hold/Call/write capture indices, cleanup and event traces and compares the complete contract. Same-F generic compatibility does not merge actual call-role rows. Integrated source_life formation keeps each bound.index mapping and its actual original source relation, then joins the header; absent role contexts reject. By-value FnMut, borrowed Once, give/escape, owned-data and owning-State restrictions are still separately checked rather than opened by a larger role count. The integrated life_result change uses the existing checked stored-callable result consumer. This review does not replace the separate broad G3.3.9 source/lending/Drop review.

checked_nonblocking_boundaries.area: Physical origin storage, keys and ABI
checked_nonblocking_boundaries.result: Origin table allocations pay actual count*size_of<Origin>; Analyze precise CFG initial/copy state pays size_of<Slot>, and provenance snapshots pay the full Origin tables. Bindings growth/COW pays Option<ClosureId> elements and Vec/Rc metadata before allocation, retained enum copies pay storage_delta_work and key comparisons include extra width. R1 is the remaining repeated linear-search work gap, not a reason to undo these real physical charges. This series does not change public Type/Wire/schema, limits or backend calling convention. Ordinary concrete function/closure arguments retain their actual types; callback Copy/effects and source qualifications remain independently enforced.
